Sandbox_MinidoracatPackThrow_ReturnEmpty: When on, the player who threw a capsule gets an empty one of the same type back once the vehicle is out, ready to pack again. Pal Spheres have their own option, "Return an empty Pal Sphere".
When on, a Pal Sphere that released its animal gives the player an empty Pal Sphere of the same tier back, ready to catch again.
Sandbox_MinidoracatPackThrow_PackPermiss:
With Minidoracat Vehicle Manager installed, a claimed vehicle can only be packed by its owner and by players the owner shared Tow with (admins need its override on); this option covers unclaimed vehicles.
Key holders: the player carries this vehicle's key, or the key is in the ignition.
Anyone: every player can pack.
Admins only: regular players cannot pack.
Admins can always pack, whatever this option says.
Sandbox_MinidoracatPackThrow_ZombieSound: Zombie attraction radius of the capsule sound (tiles)
0 to 50 tiles. 0 means the capsule popping open does not attract zombies.
Sandbox_MinidoracatPackThrow_AllowCargoT: Allow taking cargo out of capsules

When on, players can take cargo out of a loaded capsule without unpacking the vehicle. Items can only be taken out, never put in. A freshly packed capsule opens after about 5 seconds; a capsule left unconfirmed by a server crash stays locked.
Sandbox_MinidoracatPackThrow_CargoWeight:
On: a capsule holding a vehicle also weighs that vehicle's cargo.
Off: vehicles packed from now on keep their cargo in the capsule without its weight, so the capsule weighs only itself. That cargo comes out only when the vehicle is unpacked, even with "Allow taking cargo out of capsules" on.
Each capsule keeps the setting it was packed with: changing it leaves capsules already packed as they are.
Sandbox_MinidoracatPackThrow_RecordReten:
1 to 90 days. Records of capsules that were unpacked, restored or voided are deleted once their last event is older than this. Packed and unconfirmed records are always kept: they are needed to restore what was packed.
Records live on the server in Zomboid/Lua/MinidoracatPackThrow/, one folder per world; back them up with the world save.
Sandbox_MinidoracatPackThrow_LootEnabled: Empty capsules and Pal Spheres appear as loot

Master switch: when off, none of the seven locations below spawn empty capsules or Pal Spheres.
Only affects containers opened for the first time afterwards; containers already looted do not respawn.

Sandbox_MinidoracatPackThrow_AllowAnimal: When on, players can catch any live animal in the world (wild or tame, young or grown) in a Pal Sphere, from the animal's menu or by throwing an empty one. Off only stops catching animals: Pal Spheres that already hold one can still release it, and admins can restore it.
Sandbox_MinidoracatPackThrow_WildCapture: Base chance, in percent, that catching a wild animal works, from the animal's menu or by throwing a Pal Sphere. The final chance is this base plus the sphere tier bonus and the three bonuses below, at most 100. On a miss the animal breaks free and stays where it is, and the Pal Sphere is not used up (a thrown one falls where it landed). 0: wild animals can't be caught (no bonus brings them back); 100: always works. Tame animals are not affected. With "Pal Sphere lost on a failed catch" on, a miss takes the sphere too.
Pal Sphere lost on a failed catch

When on, a wild animal that breaks free on the catch roll also takes the empty Pal Sphere: from the animal's menu it is removed from the inventory, and a thrown one does not fall where it landed. Only a failed roll counts; any other miss (the target ran off, the spot is blocked and so on) keeps the sphere. Tame animals are not affected.

Sandbox_MinidoracatPackThrow_CraftCartoo: Picks the crafting recipe of this capsule type. Disabled: the crafting window neither lists nor finds it. Easy: fewer parts, lower skills, less time. Standard: the usual parts and skills. Hard: one rare part more, higher skills, more time. The recipe is in the crafting window's "Pack & Throw" category and needs a table or workbench and light; the window lists the parts and skills. It cannot be crafted while its "can pack" is off.
